content_gaps: Ranking roundups mix filed figures with third-party estimates.
Metric definitions, such as an active account, are rarely given.
Some widely ranked pages are years out of date.
Country user counts are quoted without a primary source.

verification_log.summary: Keyword data from Ubersuggest (United States), five ranking pages reviewed. Annual and quarterly headline figures checked against both releases. The 2025 Form 10-K loads and states 439 million active accounts and $1.79 trillion of payment volume. Body claims checked against the releases and the 2025 Form 10-K: 2024 payment volume and transactions, currency-neutral growth, transactions per active account, transaction margin dollars, operating margins, free cash flow, cross-border share of 12% in 2023 to 2025, 37% of volume outside the United States, and $6.0 billion of share repurchases. 2026 update of 2026-10-04: Added first-half 2026 totals and PayPal's stated third quarter and full-year 2026 guidance from the second quarter release. Editorial pass of 2026-10-05: added short attributed executive statements, each read from the cited company source with the speaker's name and title.
